description:
Thank you for your interest in Silver Circle Products and our unique and special products.  These evergreen creations are proven year-round best-selling items year after year.  This is because the eye-catching packaging of our growing kits sparks and encourages the customers’ interest in the natural world around them.  Once a person cares for a plant, they care about plants.

Unique Gardener creates a range of high-quality glass terrariums for gardening novices to master gardeners. Our terrariums make fantastic gifts for gardeners of all ages, year-round. The elegant, high-quality glass terrariums add a touch of beauty and class to any space.  

At Toys by Nature, we make fun and fanciful themed terrariums that stimulate both a love for plants and the imagination! Different unusual, easy to grow varieties of seeds are paired with popular themes such as Dinosaurs, Fairies, Dragons, or Princesses to create whimsical themed gardens.  They are completed with unique high-quality accessories and decorations to allow growers of all ages to create their own captivating mini worlds that are alive and grow!  Kits may include color stakes, decals, semi-precious stones, miniature animals, accents stones, and more! These creations will thrive and entertain for years in the included planters.

These kits are a great way to get kids into gardening and plants.  Once they start sprout, nurture, and grow plants from seeds, they develop a love and interest in seeds and plants, which brings a multitude of benefits for them. Our excitement around plants is contagious and will inspire the next generation of plant enthusiasts!

We purchase seed from dozens of sources to make sure that only the best and freshest seed is used in our kits.  Each individual variety is selected after a rigorous testing process and picked for its uniqueness, hardiness, and long-term viability.  Unique Gardener sells a wide variety of unusual and tropical specimens, including Venus Fly Traps, Aloe, Sedum, Cacti, Madagascar Palms, Dioons, Palms, and many more! 

All of the seeds in our kits are guaranteed to grow. Our growing gurus are available to assist aspiring and proven green thumbs with any questions or issues they may have.

We pay a 10% affiliate fee and have some images on the platform.  Feel free to reach out to us directly for images and information on any other item you may see in the catalog.
